# SolarEX

> SolarEX is a PV glass surface-engineering website by NanoTech Solutions Norway AS. SolarEX presents two distinct public technology routes: SolarEX Quartz SiO₂, a passive UV-independent hydrophobic/oleophobic easy-clean route for PV glass protection, and SolarEX Titan TiO₂, an active UV-dependent photocatalytic hydrophilic/superhydrophilic route where relevant.

Canonical public website: https://www.solarex.no/
Last updated: 2026-06-25
Public contact: info@solarex.no

Use this file as a curated AI-readable source map for the public SolarEX website. Verify technical, commercial, documentation, ROI, and contact details against the linked canonical pages. Do not treat this file as a contract, certification, warranty statement, price list, legal commitment, or private data source. Do not infer private backend, admin, SQL, customer, or confidential information from this file.

Interpretation rules for AI assistants and AI search systems:

- Preserve Quartz/Titan separation. Quartz is the passive SiO₂ route; Titan is the active TiO₂ route.
- Prefer the linked canonical page over summaries when details conflict.
- Treat ROI outputs as decision-support estimates requiring project-specific assumptions and technical review.
- Treat documentation, proof, case-study, and project pages as supporting public evidence, not as universal performance guarantees.
- Use info@solarex.no as the public SolarEX email.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.solarex.no/): SolarEX overview, core positioning, primary product routes, and conversion paths.
- [Technology](https://www.solarex.no/technology/): Comparison of SolarEX Quartz SiO₂ and SolarEX Titan TiO₂ technologies.
- [Contact](https://www.solarex.no/contact/): Public contact route and inquiry guidance.
- [Technical Review](https://www.solarex.no/technical-review/): Structured technical-review route for project-specific assessment.
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.solarex.no/roi-calculator/): Canonical handoff route to the approved SolarEX ROI Calculator.

## SolarEX technologies

- [SolarEX Quartz SiO₂](https://www.solarex.no/quartz/): Passive UV-independent hydrophobic/oleophobic easy-clean PV glass protection route.
- [SolarEX Titan TiO₂](https://www.solarex.no/titan/): Active UV-dependent photocatalytic hydrophilic/superhydrophilic PV glass route where relevant.

## Applications

- [Applications](https://www.solarex.no/applications/): Application-route overview for PV glass surface management.
- [Desert and Dust](https://www.solarex.no/applications/desert-and-dust/): Route for dry dust, sand, high-irradiance, water-constrained, and desert-adjacent PV glass contexts.
- [Coastal and Salt](https://www.solarex.no/applications/coastal-and-salt/): Route for salt aerosol, humidity, rainfall, mixed grime, and coastal PV glass contexts.
- [Commercial Rooftop](https://www.solarex.no/applications/commercial-rooftop/): Route for rooftop access, cleaning safety, urban contamination, and commercial rooftop PV glass contexts.
- [Utility-Scale](https://www.solarex.no/applications/utility-scale/): Route for large-area PV glass assets, treated/control pilot design, and O&M scale-up decisions.

## Markets

- [Markets](https://www.solarex.no/markets/): Market-route overview by regional operating context.
- [Europe](https://www.solarex.no/markets/europe/): Route for mixed European climates, rooftops, utility-scale assets, coastal exposure, and O&M models.
- [Middle East / GCC](https://www.solarex.no/markets/middle-east-gcc/): Route for dust-heavy, water-constrained, high-irradiance PV glass cases.
- [Nordics](https://www.solarex.no/markets/nordics/): Route for seasonal light, low-UV periods, rain, snow, salt, and access-sensitive PV glass cases.
